svg.title: Customer demand and the service engagement
svg.desc: Customer demand and the service engagement. Customer and sales order connect through a service order line to its engagement. Keep the record grains separate. Foreign-key paths, analytical matches, and business context answer different questions; read the numbered evidence table before joining.
